title: Horizontal Slider
text: Change parameter or variable value using horizontal slider with customizable appearance, {Label} sets Position of label displaying name of connected element; {Connection} sets the block parameter value to connect parameter value connection, {Minimum}, {Maximum}, {Tick Interval} sets the interval between major tick marks, {Scale Direction} sets the direction of increasing scale values, {Lock Aspect Ratio} sets the option to maintain block aspect ratio, {Origin} sets the value on scale from which handle moves and value bar, {X Offset} sets the horizontal offset of left edge of scale bounding box from left edge of block, {Y Offset} sets the vertical offset of top edge of scale bounding box from top edge of block, {Width} scales width scalar, {Height} scales height scalar, {Tick Color} sets the color of scale tick marks, span line, and block name, {Label Color} scales label font color, {Label Offset} sets the vertical distance of scale labels from free end of scale tick, {Offset from Scale} sets the distance of top edge of value bar from span, {Size} sets the value bar thickness scalar, {Use Background Color} sets the option to specify solid block background, {Color} sets the block background color, {Opacity} sets the block background opacity and {Corner Radius} sets the corner radius of area with block background color. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Connection
params.values: Block parameter value to connect parameter value connection options

params.name: Minimum
params.values: Minimum tick mark value 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Maximum
params.values: Maximum tick mark value 100 (default) | scalar

params.name: Tick Interval
params.values: Interval between major tick marks auto (default) | scalar

params.name: Scale Direction
params.values: Direction of increasing scale values ’Left to right’ (default) | ’Right to left’

params.name: Label
params.values: Position of label displaying name of connected element Hide (default) | Bottom | Top

params.name: Lock Aspect Ratio
params.values: Option to maintain block aspect ratio on (default) | off

params.name: Origin
params.values: Value on scale from which handle moves and value bar grows auto (default) | scalar

params.name: X Offset
params.values: Horizontal offset of left edge of scale bounding box from left edge of block scalar

params.name: Y Offset
params.values: Vertical offset of top edge of scale bounding box from top edge of block scalar

params.name: Width
params.values: Scale width scalar

params.name: Height
params.values: Scale height scalar

params.name: Tick Color
params.values: Color of scale tick marks, span line, and block name [r g b] vector

params.name: Label Color
params.values: Scale label font color [r g b] vector

params.name: Label Offset
params.values: Vertical distance of scale labels from free end of scale tick marks 0.3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Offset from Scale
params.values: Distance of top edge of value bar from span line 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Size
params.values: Value bar thickness scalar

params.name: Use Background Color
params.values: Option to specify solid block background color off (default) | on

params.name: Color
params.values: Block background color [r g b] vector

params.name: Opacity
params.values: Block background opacity 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Corner Radius
params.values: Corner radius of area with block background color scalar
